Full multi-rail descriptor: base+solana wallets configured for both, so runtime rail-fallback (baaa1774c) can retry on opaque-500. Lowest viable price hint ($0.01). Descriptor fetched 2026-05-25, fresh.

chosen_tools.rationale: Official CEO/company announcements live on X — direct path to authoritative source for reason_excerpt and official_statement_url per README's authoritative-source rule. Same 5-rail multi-accept as exa, both wallets cover it. Fresh lock (2026-05-25).

multirail_status: Both chosen tools advertise 5 accept rails (base USDC/USDT + solana USDC/USDT/CASH); base/USDC primary with solana/USDC as automatic fallback target — searcher can dodge the prior base/USDC opaque-500 by trying solana on retry.
notes: Discover stack collapses from 5 declared tools to 2 payable ones because the 3 stableenrich tools require a tempo wallet that's not configured. Exa's news+semantic coverage compensates for losing serper_news. Reddit social_signal will be missing this run — acceptable for discover; curate/refresh can pick it up if a tempo wallet is added later.
